name: ichiran-node
description: Node.js/TypeScript port of Ichiran Japanese text segmentation library

scripts.build: cd packages/core && bun run build && cd ../grammar && bun run build && cd ../api && bun run build && cd ../cli && bun run build && cd ../data && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/core && bun run typecheck && cd ../grammar && bun run typecheck && cd ../api && bun run typecheck && cd ../cli && bun run typecheck && cd ../data && bun run typecheck && cd ../.. && bun run alpha:release:typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages/*/tests/
scripts.test:parity: bun run build && RUN_PARITY_TESTS=true bun test packages/*/tests/
scripts.alpha:release:build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun scripts/browser-alpha-release.ts build
scripts.alpha:release:verify: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun scripts/browser-alpha-release.ts verify
scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,grammar,api -c blue,magenta,green "cd packages/core && bun run build:watch" "cd packages/grammar && bun run build:watch" "tsx --watch --env-file=.env packages/api/src/index.ts"
